title: gentianella austriaca subsp. praecox
intro: Gentianella austriaca subsp. praecox, commonly known as Early Gentian or Alpine Spring Gentian, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the gentian family, typically found in alpine regions. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its potential to stimulate digestion and relieve symptoms of indigestion and nausea. The therapeutic actions of Gentianella austriaca subsp. praecox are attributed to its bitter compounds, which can stimulate appetite and improve the flow of digestive juices. Bioactive constituents of the plant include iridoid glycosides and other compounds with potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
